name: Studio Fran Viñas
notes: Studio Fran Viñas Arquitectos, Córdoba (Argentina), in the Cerro de las Rosas a few blocks from the Mujer Urbana interchange (placed at its town: no street address found); an architects' studio on a narrow mid-block lot between a white two-storey shop building and a cream house behind a garden. From the article's photographs (street views in daylight and at dusk, the entry, the stair, interiors): a black steel portal on the street line, glazed across, with a white-gravel entry court and a potted tree inside it; at the back of the court the light-grey perforated aluminium screen with a deep red-orange box for the door; above and behind the portal a long narrow prism two storeys higher, charcoal at its sides, its street face a perforated screen over glazing in a black frame, and a green roof terrace with a railing, reached by the red spiral stair at the rear. Changed over three rounds: the neighbours shortened and lowered (the east shop building had swallowed the studio), the upper volume narrowed to about 3.8 m against the portal's 6.4 (their ratio in the frontal photograph) and moved a little west of centre, the body cut to 9.5 m (the 96 m2 built area given for it, over three levels, allows no more). Guessed: all dimensions (the lot taken as 7 m wide), the rear and the stair bay (not shown), the neighbours' heights and materials and the street trees. The door red is the corten ink, the nearest the palette has.
